Good evening, and welcome. My name is Jake, and I am your waiter tonight. We have two specials. The first is a grilled fish with rice. It is twenty-eight dollars. The second is a steak with potatoes. It is thirty-two dollars. For dessert, I recommend the key lime pie. It is very popular in Miami. Would you like a few minutes with the menu?

Many visitors ask me about tips in the United States. Here is the answer. In most restaurants, the tip is not included in the check. A normal tip is eighteen to twenty percent. When the waiter brings the check, there is a line for the tip. You write the tip, and you write the total. If the service is very good, you can leave more. Simple, right?

Carlos and his wife arrive at the restaurant. The waiter gives them a table for two. They read the menu. Carlos says: I would like the fish. At the end, he asks for the check. He writes a tip of twenty percent.
